# Scotiabank (BNS) Deep Dive Analysis

Report 040 | Published 2020-11-22 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2020-11-22/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/040.json)

Rotation, Bitcoin momentum, and bank value.

Bitcoin direction and the bond-yield rebound were strong calls. The BTI and BNS replacements outperformed BIPC in disclosed three- and five-year sensitivities. Scotiabank itself eventually delivered solid absolute returns but lagged SPY. The claims that reserve status requires trade deficits and equal weighting proves breadth need correction.

**Coverage:** All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

### 040-C02

**Reserve status requires trade deficits**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | US external balance |
| Source blocks | 17 |
| Thesis family | triffin-current-account-necessity |

Bank-created dollar liabilities and gross capital flows can supply foreign dollar assets without a US trade deficit. The cited BIS research explains this distinction. Reserve demand can affect exchange rates, but it does not make deindustrialization an accounting necessity.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [How does international capital flow?](https://www.bis.org/publications/working-paper-890-how-does-international-capital-flow) | Michael Kumhof et al. / BIS | 2020-10-01 | Verified in the audit

Authors explain that international bank money creation does not require a US current-account deficit; gross financial flows and net resource flows are distinct. Working-paper views are the authors' rather than official BIS policy.

### 040-C04

**Equal-weight implies majority leadership**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | Equity breadth |
| Source blocks | 24 |
| Thesis family | equalweight-breadth-identity |

Relative average returns do not reveal how many constituents outperform. A minority of extreme winners can lift equal weight above cap weight while most stocks lag. See the bounded arithmetic counterexample.

**Direction:** See reason; no return inferred.

**Timing:** No fixed endpoint supplied.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Deductive assessment:**

- Three stocks have capitalization weights 80%,10%,10%.
- Their same-period returns are 0%,100%,0%; equal weights are one-third.

Cap-weight return is 10%; equal-weight return is 33.33%. Only one of three stocks outperforms the 10% cap-weight index, so equal-weight outperformance does not imply a majority of constituents outperform.

**Outcome evidence:**

No independent outcome source is recorded. Any deductive assessment is identified separately.

**Timing:** Original horizon retained: 3-5 years

**Mechanism:** Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

**Reviewer confidence:** medium

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Scotiabank stated-horizon sensitivities](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/BNS/history/) | Yahoo Finance | Verified in the audit

November 23, 2020-November 22, 2023 BNS adjusted-close+5.98%, SPY 33.10%; to November 21, 2025 BNS+79.04%, annualized 12.37%, SPY 97.76%. USD vendor distribution/split proxies, before taxes/fees.

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.
- Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
